main.description: A check of one of a repository's workflows, as its runner reported it: each step, and the end of what they printed. Only a check by a runner the repository's record names is found. No authentication; responses are not personalized.

errors.description: No such repository, or no such check of it by a runner it names.
errors.name: NotFound

log.description: The end of what its steps printed, each step's after a line `==> <name>`.

pull.description: The dev.knotless.pull it ran for, if it ran for one.

ref.description: The ref it ran at, in full, such as refs/heads/main.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record. Its authority may be a handle; a name the repository had before, or an owner it moved from with its agreement, finds it under the name it has now.

uri.description: The dev.knotless.check record, by a runner the repository names.

description: A check of one of a repository's workflows.
